title: External services need approved risk, interface and oversight evidence
remediation: The sponsor service owner, privacy lead and acquiring authority approve security outsourcing after a scoped risk assessment. Obtain provider declarations for required functions, ports, protocols and services. Record assigned responsibilities, evidence and review cadence for each assessed provider, and verify a representative oversight review with findings and follow-up. Keep X3 as the separate export-control route path.

milestones.title: Collect an approved pre-acquisition risk decision, provider interface inventory, assigned responsibilities and a dated monitoring result
